name: documentation
description: Golden documentation-authoring cases: pull_request.opened events (built from authly simulation scenarios) whose merged changes require the workflow to update or create docs

cases.name: oauth-authentication-add
cases.input: PR: add OAuth authentication. The SDK now supports building OAuth authorization URLs and exchanging an authorization code for an access token, with GitHub and Google providers and OAuth-backed login. Documentation does not yet describe the OAuth flow, callback handling, or provider setup.
cases.expected_output: OAuth must be documented: how to build an authorization URL, exchange an authorization code for an access token, handle the OAuth callback, configure GitHub and Google providers, and use OAuth-backed login.

changed_files.change: added OAuth authorization URL building and authorization-code exchange
added OAuth-backed login (exchange code for token, start session)
added OAuth configuration and client wiring

cases.name: pkce-authorization-support
cases.input: PR: add PKCE support to OAuth. The SDK now generates a code_verifier and code_challenge when building authorization URLs and uses them in the token exchange, protecting public clients. Documentation does not yet mention PKCE.
cases.expected_output: PKCE must be documented: enable PKCE when building an authorization URL, and how the token exchange uses the code verifier and code challenge.

changed_files.change: added PKCE code_verifier/code_challenge generation and token-exchange support

cases.name: api-key-authentication-removal
cases.input: PR: remove API key authentication. Client creation no longer accepts api_key; callers must use OAuth authorization instead. Docs still reference api_key in getting-started and the client reference and must be updated.
cases.expected_output: API-key authentication removal must be documented: client creation no longer accepts api_key, so callers must use OAuth authorization.
